$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

notes.description: Why these values (feel targets, references), for owner review.

height.description: Standing capsule height, feet to crown, m; at least 2 × radius.

crouchHeight.description: Crouched capsule height, m; at least 2 × radius and at most height. The feet stay put, the top lowers.

capsule.description: The player’s collision capsule (vertical, feet at the character position).

run.description: Top speed with the move input fully deflected, m/s. Partial input walks.

sprint.description: Top speed while sprint is held, m/s; at least run.

crouch.description: Top speed while crouched, m/s; at most run.

speeds.description: Top ground speeds, m/s. Analog input scales them (half deflection = half speed).

accelTime.description: Time to reach run speed from rest on the ground, s.

decelTime.description: Time to stop from run speed on the ground once input is released, s.

airControl.description: Share of ground acceleration available in the air, 0–1; with no input the player keeps momentum.

jumpApex.description: Jump height from standing, feet to feet, m.

coyoteMs.description: After walking off a ledge a jump still works for this long, whole ms (≤ 120).

jumpBufferMs.description: A jump pressed this long before landing fires on landing, whole ms (≤ 150).

stepHeight.description: Tallest step walked up without jumping, m; also how far the player snaps down to stay on stairs and ramps. Below crouchHeight.

slopeLimit.description: Steepest walkable slope, degrees; steeper ground is a wall the player slides off.

gait.description: Locomotion states and events; absent = the sim’s defaults (DEFAULT_GAIT_TUNING).

walkFrom.description: Horizontal speed from which a character with move input walks (below: idle), m/s.

runFrom.description: Horizontal speed from which it runs (below: walk), m/s; above walkFrom.

landingMs.description: How long the landing state lasts after a hard landing, whole ms.

hardLanding.description: Impact speed from which a landing counts as hard (shows the landing state), m/s.

footstep.description: Ground distance between footsteps per gait, m (half a stride): footstep events come from the distance travelled, not from animation.

launch.description: Being thrown by an impulse; absent = the sim’s defaults (DEFAULT_LAUNCH_TUNING).

airControl.description: Share of ground acceleration available while flying from an impulse the player chose (a self-cast Gust), 0–1; a staggering launch (a blast, a troll’s blow) has none.

recoveryMs.description: After a staggering launch lands, movement and jump input are ignored this long, whole ms (≤ 1000).

mass.description: The character’s mass for force stimuli (its `weight` world property), kg: a blast’s impulse in N·s over this is the velocity change it gets.

ledge.description: Mantling and ledge hangs; absent = the sim’s defaults (DEFAULT_LEDGE_TUNING).

autoMantleHeight.description: Ledges up to this high above the feet are mantled by walking into them, no jump needed, m.

mantleHeight.description: Ledges up to this high are mantled by pressing jump at them (every class), m; at least autoMantleHeight.

hangReach.description: Highest ledge above the feet a grab reaches (ledge hang, capability-gated), m; at least mantleHeight.

hangDepth.description: How far below the ledge top the feet hang, m; at most hangReach. Grabs lower than this pull straight up.

reach.description: How far ahead of the capsule a jump press finds a ledge to mantle or grab from the ground, m.

grabReach.description: How far ahead of the capsule hands catch a ledge in the air, or walking into one (auto-mantle), m.

maxTopSlope.description: Steepest ledge top a mantle stands on, degrees.

autoMantleMs.description: Duration of a mantle onto a ledge up to autoMantleHeight, whole ms.

mantleMs.description: Duration of a mantle onto a higher ledge, whole ms.

pullUpMs.description: Duration of a pull-up from a hang (or a catch low on a ledge), whole ms.

grabMs.description: Duration of catching a ledge into a hang, whole ms.

lowerMs.description: Duration of lowering over an edge into a hang, whole ms.

shimmySpeed.description: Sideways speed while hanging, at full stick deflection, m/s.

shimmyGap.description: Widest gap between ledges a shimmy crosses, m; wider gaps stop it.

slipGraceMs.description: How long hands hold a ledge that became impossible to hold (frozen, burning) before the character drops, whole ms.

away.description: Speed away from the wall, m/s.

jumpBack.description: Jumping off a hang, away from the wall.

climb.description: Climbing surfaces and ropes; absent = the sim’s defaults (DEFAULT_CLIMB_TUNING).

ladder.description: Climbing speed on a ladder, m/s.

rope.description: Climbing speed on a rope, m/s.

rough.description: Climbing speed on rough stone or timber, m/s.

sheer.description: Climbing speed on a sheer face (with a tool), m/s.

speeds.description: Surface-space speed per climbing grade at full stick deflection, m/s (a frozen surface climbs at its own grade’s speed).

walkOn.description: Grades a character attaches to by walking into them; every other grade needs a jump at it (or a catch in the air), so bumping a stone wall never starts a climb.

reach.description: How far ahead of the capsule a surface or rope can be caught, m.

handHeight.description: Hands above the feet while climbing, m: the surface must reach this high, and a ledge this high above the feet is pulled up onto.

maxCornerAngle.description: Sharpest turn between two faces a climber follows round a corner, degrees.

slipGraceMs.description: How long a climber holds a surface that became impossible to hold (frozen, burning) before falling, whole ms.

staminaPerSecond.description: Stamina drained while climbing (characters with a stamina pool), stamina/s; at 0 stamina the climber falls. Progression may change it (mw-e10.9).

away.description: Speed away from the surface, m/s.

stealth.description: MovementStance and gait movement profiles; absent = the sim’s defaults (DEFAULT_STEALTH_TUNING).

speed.description: Top speed while the slow-walk modifier is held, m/s; at most speeds.crouch.

deflection.description: Move-stick deflection at or below which moving counts as a slow walk (a light stick), 0–1.

slowWalk.description: The slow walk: the quietest gait, from the modifier or a light stick.

noise.description: Footstep noise multiplier, 0–1 (stand-sprint is 1): what stealth noise (mw-e09.5) scales by.

visibility.description: Visibility multiplier, 0–1 (stand-sprint is 1): what visibility scoring (mw-e09.2) scales by.

noise.description: Footstep noise multiplier, 0–1 (stand-sprint is 1): what stealth noise (mw-e09.5) scales by.

visibility.description: Visibility multiplier, 0–1 (stand-sprint is 1): what visibility scoring (mw-e09.2) scales by.

profiles.description: Noise and visibility for every stance × gait (every combination must be defined).

water.description: Wading, swimming and breath; absent = the sim’s defaults (DEFAULT_WATER_TUNING).

wadeDepth.description: Water at least this deep at the feet slows the character to a wade, m.

swimDepth.description: Water deeper than this at the feet is swum in (light and medium load) or sunk in (heavy and overloaded), m.

sinkFromLoadClass.description: The lightest armor load class that sinks in deep water (medium: the owner’s "going in the river makes you sink with all the armor"); lighter loads swim.

wadeScale.description: Wading speed as a share of the run speed (no sprint while wading), 0–1.

light.description: Swim speed at light load, m/s.

medium.description: Swim speed at medium load, m/s.

swimSpeed.description: Swim speed per armor load class (heavy and overloaded sink, they do not swim).

swimAccelTime.description: Time for a swimmer to reach full speed and to stop, s.

light.description: Stamina drained while swimming at light load, stamina/s.

medium.description: Stamina drained while swimming at medium load, stamina/s.

staminaPerSecond.description: Stamina drained while swimming (characters with a stamina pool); none for heavy loads, which sink.

floatDepth.description: How far below the surface a floating swimmer’s feet hang, m (the head stays above).

diveSpeed.description: Descent speed of a swimmer who dives (crouch held), m/s.

riseSpeed.description: Speed a swimmer floats back up to the surface, m/s.

sinkSpeed.description: Speed a heavily loaded character descends through deep water, m/s.

sinkScale.description: Walking speed along the bottom for a character that sank, as a share of the run speed, 0–1.

headHeight.description: Height of the mouth above the feet, m: breath runs out while the surface is above it.

breathSeconds.description: Breath underwater before drowning starts (20 by the design), s.

breathRecoverSeconds.description: Time for an empty breath meter to refill once the head is above water, s.

intervalMs.description: Time between drowning damage events once breath has run out, whole ms.

damage.description: Placeholder damage per drowning event until the damage model (e04) prices it, points.

drowning.description: What running out of breath does.

classes.description: Per-class overrides (mw-e02.3): class → only the values it changes; the rest come from this profile. Armor load effects are not overrides (mw-e17.13).
